verdict.rationale: HumanLayer has its own pieces of this flow: users can paste images (such as mockups) into a new task, choose a PRD-Oriented or Oneshot workflow, have a coding agent implement the change, and ask it to open a draft PR. Nothing in the evidence shows design-to-code conversion specifically, and the setup (repositories, workspace config, agent install) and review-oriented workflows assume engineering involvement. Missing for 10: documented mockup/design-to-implementation flow, evidence that a non-engineer can complete it without engineering handoff, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: Paste images straight into the new task composer as attachments.
A clear and small change can use Oneshot.
Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
